scope: Project-author multidimensional strength styles only, not calibrated human ranks, player heat-maps, guaranteed win rates or native behavior certification.
anchor_policy: The old eight tier IDs and values are II anchors; radiant is the final sole rank. Iron I extrapolates one third of the first anchor interval downward and clamps to legal metadata bounds. Other subranks interpolate adjacent II anchors.

strength_dimensions.interpolation: Extra dimensions use linear author-selected endpoints over ordinal0..24, equivalent to interpolating the corresponding II anchor samples. The original15 legacy anchor dimensions retain their existing exact values and piecewise interpolation.
strength_dimensions.protected: Shared query budgets, FOV and physical limits, damage, health, native movement/weapon speed, semantic constants, source-unavailable12 parameters, weapon firing style matrices and action usage weights remain defaults.
